basic_info.description: Welcome to 121 Seal Rock Drive, an exceptionally charming ocean view residence located on a quiet street close to the Lands End Trail and Sutro Heights. Upon entering through the stunning glass front door you will be greeted by a striking newly remodeled permitted kitchen opening onto the light filled formal dining room perfect for entertaining and spacious living room featuring a corner wood burning fireplace with decorative mantel. Both the living and dining rooms boast gleaming parquet floors and gorgeous ocean views. To the left of the front entry you will find a spacious bathroom with tub, separate stall shower and built-in vanity. Two generous bedrooms with good sized closets complete the main level. The lower level features an open great room, laundry room plus an office offering french doors leading to a lovely deck surrounded by a lush landscaped terraced garden. This outstanding residence is a nature lovers' paradise with the Lands End Trail and Ocean Beach just a few steps away. Take an easy stroll to the Seal Rock Inn for a delightful weekend brunch. Excellent transportation is within one block.
